sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression of the HA-tagged construct was confirmed by anti-HA staining in surface-expression and trafficking assays; electrophysiological function of the tagged channel is not explicitly reported for the tag-bearing construct itself.
sites.rationale: L1 directly reports a full-length, membrane-anchored human KCNA2 construct with an HA epitope inserted in the extracellular loop between S1 (TM1, 164-182) and S2 (TM2, 222-242), which by the authoritative topology landmarks corresponds to residues 183-221. No specific junction residue is named in either L1 or L2, so insert_after_residue is left null and the site is classified as region-level. The loop is 39 residues long and fully extracellular, providing ample space for a short epitope tag. The N-terminal EGFP/mRFP1 fusions in the same constructs are intracellular and are recorded separately in other_positions. Full-length human KV1.2 (KCNA2) constructs bearing an N-terminal EGFP or mRFP1 fusion and an extracellular HA tag inserted 'between transmembrane helices S1 and S2' were used for surface-expression studies in transfected cells (L1). A parallel rat Kv1.2 construct with the same S1-S2 HA insertion was used for surface trafficking studies (L2, indirect). Neither paper names a specific residue junction within the loop.

sources.claim:
This resulted in a variant of interest in KCNA2 : Chr1(GRCh37):g.111146452C>T ENST00000485317:c.953G>A (p.Gly318Asp).
pcDNA3 plasmids containing human K V 1.2 with an N‐terminally fused enhanced green fluorescent protein (EGFP) or a monomeric red fluorescent protein (mRFP1) tag and an extracellular haemagglutinin (HA) site (between transmembrane helices S1 and S2, as applicable) were used; these constructs were synthesized as described previously (Nilsson et al., 2022 ).

literature_notes: L3 (PMC13083917) was disqualified: the HA described there is a separate co-transfected surface-protein reporter, not an insertion into KCNA2 itself. L4 and L5 (PMC11415962) describe HA and FLAG tags engineered 'before the stop codon' of KV1.2, placing them at the intracellular C-terminus (topology landmarks: 411-499 intracellular); these are recorded in other_positions. The N-terminal EGFP/mRFP1 fusions in L1 and L2 are also intracellular (N-terminus 1-163 is intracellular) and are likewise in other_positions. No ledger line pins a specific residue junction within the S1-S2 loop, so the site is region-level with insert_after_residue null. The three other extracellular loops (S3-S4 loop 276-289 and S5-P loop 350-388) have no ledger support for any insertion and are not proposed.

literature_other_positions.note: HA and FLAG tags engineered before the stop codon (C-terminal) of KV1.2 for western blot detection; the C-terminus (411-499) is intracellular per topology landmarks.
N-terminal EGFP and mRFP1 fusions on full-length KCNA2; the N-terminus (1-163) is intracellular, so these are cytoplasmic tags, not surface tags.
